title: Identifier
description: A locally-unique identifier for this node.

title: Name
description: A name for this node. The name should be unique amongst the nodes belonging to a network.

title: Status
description: The status of this node, from the closed [nodeStatus codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodestatus).

title: Location
description: The physical location of this node.

title: Street address
description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

title: Locality
description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

title: Country
description: The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

title: Type
description: The type of supporting infrastructure, from the open [nodeSupportingInfrastructure codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#nodesupportinginfrastructure).

title: Description
description: A description of the supporting infrastructure for this node.

title: Spare capacity
description: Whether the supporting infrastructure has spare capacity for the installation of additional network equipment.

title: Access point
description: Whether active or passive transmission equipment is installed at this node which is capable of providing access to the network.

title: Street address
description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

title: Locality
description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

title: Country
description: The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

title: Power availability
description: Whether power for active network equipment is available at this node.
